Coverage: (a) authz — every new endpoint (GET /admin/payments/gateways, GET /admin/payments/transactions, POST /admin/wallet/adjust, GET /admin/wallet/report) returns 401/403 unauthenticated and 403 for both buyer and seller tokens; (b) gateway CRUD — invalid provider 'paypal' -> 400; create cryptomus + nowpayments both 200 with correct fields; list contains the new item; PUT toggles enabled; DELETE 200 and item disappears; (c) monitoring — GET /admin/payments/transactions returns {transactions, summary{pending,completed,failed,refunded}}, every txn has monitorStatus/orderTitle/userEmail; ?status=pending filter honored; PATCH .../{id}/refund on unknown id -> 404 (the idempotent-refund test was skipped because monitoring summary currently reports 0 completed txns — the previously-paid order o_6b5f3d609410 shows monitorStatus='pending' since no payment_transactions row is stored with status=completed / payment_status=paid; see caveat below); (d) wallet — validation for missing note (400), amount<=0 (400), unknown userId (404), invalid type (400); positive flow qabuyer: credit +25 -> bonus +10 -> debit -5 with balanceAfter arithmetic verified; over-debit blocked (400); GET /admin/users/{id} reflects new walletBalance; GET /admin/wallet/report returns totalBalance + totals{credit,debit,bonus}+counts + recent[] with userEmail and note fields. FRONTEND (real browser, admin login): /admin/console loads, admin-tab-payments and admin-tab-wallet render. Gateway form (provider=cryptomus + all fields) submits, appears in gateway-list, gateway-toggle-<id> flips enabled, gateway-delete-<id> removes it from DOM. All 5 payments-filter chips exist and are clickable; payments-table renders 'No payments found' empty state under completed filter and 3 rows under pending. Wallet tab: search 'qabuyer' -> wallet-user-option-<id> renders, click -> wallet-selected-user shows 'QA Buyer / qabuyer@example.com / $60'; empty-note submit is blocked (balance unchanged); valid submit type=credit amount=3 note='UI test credit' updates card to $63 and toast 'Wallet updated New balance: $63' appears; report cards populated: total=$63, deposits=$0, credits=$28, debits=$25, bonuses=$60; wallet-recent-adjustments shows the newest 'UI test credit' row at top. Regression: overview, users, sms tabs all open without console errors. Screenshots saved.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1387 lines and hosts auth, catalog, orders, payments/Stripe, receipts, SMS, admin, wallet, gateways. Overdue for splitting into routers/services (payments_admin.py, wallet_admin.py, sms_admin.py).

Payment Monitoring reports monitorStatus='pending' for orders that ARE actually paid on the orders collection (e.g., o_6b5f3d609410 has paymentStatus=paid) because _monitor_status only inspects the payment_transactions row, and _mark_paid does not update payment_transactions.status to 'completed' when the Stripe hosted-checkout poll succeeds. Consider setting payment_transactions.status='completed' + payment_status='paid' inside _mark_paid so admin monitoring reflects reality; today the Completed column will always be 0.

/api/admin/wallet/adjust stores wallet_transactions.type='debit' with a NEGATIVE amount, but the wallet_report totals compute abs(amount) per type — inconsistent sign semantics (credit/bonus stored positive, debit negative). Either store all positives (sign implied by type) or update report to sum raw amount. Not user-facing today but fragile.

gateway_create stores apiKey/secretKey in plaintext in Mongo and returns them via GET /admin/payments/gateways. Even for 'config only' storage, encrypt at rest (e.g., Fernet with a server key) and mask secretKey/apiKey when listing (only return last-4 or ***).
Gateway list has no pagination and monitoring caps at 200 txns — fine now, will need cursor/limit params later.
AdminConsole.jsx is 745 lines and holds Overview, Users, SMS, Payments, Wallet tabs inline. Splitting per-tab into files/ folder would help testability.

rca of the issue: Skipped refund test — root cause: _mark_paid updates orders.paymentStatus=paid + orders.status=processing but does NOT touch the corresponding payment_transactions row's status field. _monitor_status therefore falls through to 'pending' for the paid Stripe row. Mitigation for main agent (optional, low priority — user asked only for read-only monitoring): inside _mark_paid also do `await db.payment_transactions.update_one({'session_id': session_id}, {'$set': {'status': 'completed', 'payment_status': 'paid', 'updated_at': now_iso()}})` after order is marked paid. This will surface real completed payments in the admin Completed chip and enable end-to-end refund UI verification.
